result.note: Minor institutional announcement; one question on the council's chair and the separate directorate's role.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Ministry of Steel announced a Steel Industry Safety Council. Consider the following statements:
items: The council will be chaired by the Union Minister of Steel.
A separate Steel Industry Safety Directorate will run safety audits and investigate serious incidents.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The council will be chaired by the steel secretary, not the minister. It will approve industry safety standards and review serious accidents and near misses. A new directorate will handle audits and investigations.
questions.source: The Ministry of Steel will set up a Steel Industry Safety Council, chaired by the steel secretary, to approve industry safety standards and review serious accidents and near misses.
